reason: The price is nothing for us, but this is a manual blast pack: send an Excel file over WhatsApp and someone loads it. I want order confirmations firing automatically from the website, POS and WooCommerce, and nothing here says it connects to any of that.
objection: It doesn't plug into my shop system, so it's one more separate tool my staff have to remember to use, and 1,000 credits barely covers one blast across several branches' customers.
would_change_my_mind: A WooCommerce plugin or API that connects to my POS so order confirmations and sale messages send automatically under my shop's name.
